description.value:
As part of the action used to cast this power, you must make a ranged weapon attack against a creature within your weapon's range, or the power fails. On a hit, the attack deals its normal damage, and you plant a marker on the target visible only to you; the next attack roll made against that creature before the end of your next turn cannot be made with disadvantage.

At 5th level, the initial ranged attack deals an extra 1d6 damage of the weapon's type; this bonus damage increases by another 1d6 at 11th and 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
